label: Separate one-bit, pair and finite-pattern freedom with constant and parity suffixes
description: Constant suffixes separate single-coordinate freedom from joint pair freedom. The three-periodic XOR construction gives each adjacent pair by a suitable seed choice, but one fixed two-step equation forbids three consecutive true values. Matching the two seed coordinates fixes every admitted trace. Thus the exact first-order Profile obstruction does not exclude deterministic higher-order regularity or show unrestricted history recombination. #1874 independently supplies the finite-versus-infinite strictness control; it is reused rather than recreated.
